messages:
marta: quick draft up in the RN doc — trying to keep the internal note one short paragraph + a monitoring CTA. can someone sanity-check?
josh: on it. what are the exact rollback gates we want ops to use? i prefer numeric thresholds.
priya: suggest: rollback if p99 latency increases >25% from baseline OR request_error_rate > 1.5% sustained for 3m. keep language tight.
ops-oncall: ok those are actionable. also include CPU > 80% as an additional gate. and say ‘sustained for 3m’ for errors/cpu.
marta: adding that. also want to pin the serving artifact to avoid accidental auto-updates during the rollout.
josh: pin: `serve/redwood-infer:2026-03-21-quantb-v2`. fallback: `serve/redwood-infer:2026-01-30-fast`
priya: nice. heres the compact internal snippet i propose: "Internal: rolling canary for batching tuning to improve short-session p99. Expected ~10-15% p99 reduction. Monitor canary for 20m. Rollback if p99 >25% above baseline OR errors >1.5% for 3m OR CPU >80% for 3m. Model pinned to serve/redwood-infer:2026-03-21-quantb-v2 (fallback: 2026-01-30-fast). Ops oncall: @ops-oncall. Links: PR https://git.internal/rn/4321, smoke: https://ci.internal/6543"
ops-oncall: please add a deploybot tag so the bot links back to this snippet: `deploybot:tag=rn_batch_pin,quiet_window=00:20`. that helps audit and quiet the channel.
marta: can someone start a small canary with that tag? want to confirm the deploybot summary includes the pinned artifact.
josh: kicking off canary now. note: west1 warmup can show a spike, well ignore transient blips under 2m.

deploy-bot: Canary start accepted:
```
canary id: cb-20260321-92
model: serve/redwood-infer:2026-03-21-quantb-v2
percent: 5%
start_ts: 1781234600
```
ops-oncall: watching dashboard. ill post a +10m health update.
priya: final pass on copy: include one line for product: "no user-visible changes expected." short and clear.
marta: added product line. ready to pin to the internal announce thread after 20m if green.

deploy-bot: Canary health (10m):
```
cb-20260321-92: p50 48ms (+2%), p95 190ms (-6%), p99 350ms (-9%)
errors: 0.8%
CPU: 58%
status: healthy
```
ops-oncall: 10m looks fine. will post 20m summary.
josh: prepping public RN microcopy in docs repo so it's ready to publish once we get +20m green.
priya: docs acked and ready. :thumbsup:
ops-oncall: 20m summary: all thresholds clear. rolling per plan to the rest of fleet.
marta: rolling. thanks folks  i'll post final public blurb and close this thread shortly.
